events.title: Iran Conflict Escalation
events.summary: The Iran conflict is escalating, with the US and Iran engaging in military actions. This has led to increased tensions in the Middle East and a rise in oil prices. The conflict is expected to continue, with potential for further escalation.
events.reasoning: The Iran conflict is expected to lead to higher oil prices, which will benefit oil services companies. On the other hand, emerging markets are likely to be negatively impacted by the conflict.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil prices and conflict escalation

events.exitStrategy: Exit when oil prices peak or conflict de-escalates

events.title: Fed Holds Interest Rates Steady
events.summary: The Federal Reserve has decided to hold interest rates steady, despite inflation concerns. This decision is expected to impact the US economy and financial markets.
events.reasoning: The Fed's decision to hold interest rates steady is expected to boost the stock market, while bonds may be negatively impacted.
events.exitStrategy: Exit when interest rates rise or economy slows

gains.extendedNote: If economy surprises to the upside
